name: Day of Judgement
sub: The Trumpet to the final home

events.title: The Trumpet
events.summary: All in the heavens and earth fall dead, then stand up looking on.

steps.title: The first blow
steps.summary: All in the heavens and earth fall dead, except whom Allah wills.

steps.title: The gap of forty
steps.summary: Abu Huraira said there is forty between the two blowings and would not say whether days, months, or years; then rain falls and bodies grow again like plants.

steps.title: The second blow
steps.summary: The Trumpet sounds again and all stand up, looking on.

events.title: Resurrection
events.summary: From the graves they hasten to their Lord.

steps.title: Raised bare and barefoot
steps.summary: All are gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised, as they were first created.

steps.title: Ibrahim clothed first
steps.summary: The first person to be clothed on that Day is Ibrahim.

events.title: The Gathering
events.summary: The sun is brought near; people stand in sweat by their deeds.

steps.title: The sun brought near
steps.summary: The sun is brought so close to the people that only a mile is left between them.

steps.title: Sweat by their deeds
steps.summary: People stand in their own sweat according to their deeds: some to the ankles, some to the knees, some to the waist, and some drowning in it.

events.title: The Intercession
events.summary: People go from prophet to prophet until they reach Muhammad ﷺ.

steps.title: They go to Adam
steps.summary: People ask Adam, father of mankind, to intercede; he recalls his own sin and sends them on.

steps.title: They go to Nuh
steps.summary: Nuh recalls the one dua he once made against his people and sends them on.

steps.title: They go to Ibrahim
steps.summary: Ibrahim recalls three sayings that were not strictly true and sends them on.

steps.title: They go to Musa
steps.summary: Musa recalls killing a man he was not commanded to kill and sends them on.

steps.title: They go to Isa
steps.summary: Isa names no sin of his own, but still sends them on, to Muhammad.

steps.title: Muhammad intercedes
steps.arabic: شفاعة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
steps.summary: He prostrates beneath the Throne in praise of his Lord, is told to raise his head and ask, and his intercession is granted.

events.title: The Book is given
events.summary: Given in the right hand, or the left.

steps.title: Given in the right hand
steps.summary: The believer's record is given into his right hand, and he shares it with joy.

steps.title: Given behind the back
steps.summary: The wrongdoer's record is given from behind him, and he wishes for destruction.

events.title: The Scales
events.summary: Just scales; not a mustard seed's weight is missed.

steps.title: Deeds are weighed
steps.summary: Allah sets up just scales; not a soul will be wronged in anything, not even the weight of a mustard seed.

steps.title: The card outweighs the scrolls
steps.summary: A man is shown ninety-nine scrolls of sin, then a card bearing the shahadah is placed on the scale and outweighs them all.

events.title: The Pool
events.summary: The Prophet's pool; whoever drinks never thirsts again.

steps.title: The Prophet waits at the Pool
steps.summary: His pool takes a month to cross, whiter than milk and sweeter than musk; whoever drinks from it never thirsts again.

steps.title: Some are turned away
steps.summary: Some he recognises as his companions are pulled away before him, told they changed the religion after he left them.

events.title: The Bridge
events.summary: A bridge over Jahannam, crossed at the speed of one's deeds.

steps.title: The bridge is set over Hell
steps.summary: A bridge is laid across Jahannam, slippery, with hooks and spikes that catch as it is crossed.

steps.title: Steadfast, O Lord
steps.summary: As they cross, people plead: Allah, keep safe, keep safe.

steps.title: Crossed at the speed of deeds
steps.summary: Believers pass like the blink of an eye, like lightning, like wind, like birds, or like fine horses, while others are scratched, held back, or fall into the Fire.

events.title: Jannah or Jahannam
events.summary: Driven in groups to the Garden, or to the Fire; and faces that day looking at their Lord.

steps.title: Driven to the Garden
steps.summary: Those who feared their Lord are driven to Paradise in groups, its gates opened for them.

steps.title: Looking at their Lord
steps.summary: Some faces that Day will be radiant, looking at their Lord.

steps.title: Driven to the Fire
steps.summary: Those who disbelieved are driven to Hell in groups.
